chunks: And he will think that it is the parting.

key_terms.ظَنَّ: To think, suppose, or believe (often with a sense of assumption or realization)

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when a person realizes it is the parting?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase captures the profound regret of the disbeliever who, upon facing the reality of the Hereafter, realizes that the ultimate separation (al-firāq) is from the truth and the Prophet's household he neglected. It underscores the finality of this parting, contrasting the fleeting attachment to worldly illusions with the eternal consequence of spiritual loss.
